title: erucastrum obtusangulum
intro: Erucastrum obtusangulum, commonly known as Rocket Cress or Sharavathi Rocket, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing inflammation, protecting against cell damage, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Erucastrum obtusangulum include its use in treating digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of the plant have been reported to possess anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities.
